notes.content: History majors are strongly encouraged to include the study of a foreign language and literature in their programs. Students are also required to take one history course that fulfills the gender, race, and ethnicity requirement (from a list of approved courses available from the Undergraduate Advisor). Group 3: The History/Social Science teaching specialization is designed for prospective secondary History/Social Science teachers. Students receive a B.A. in History, but they complete a sequence of classes that satisfies the state-mandated requirement in subject matter competence for the Single Subject Teaching Credential. Complete Group 3 and all upper-division courses. Group 4: Students should select US History as one of their fields of emphasis. Complete Group 4 and all upper-division courses. Consult the CSULB Catalog and History department for additional details.
